title: answer body
description: The answer to a question. Ends the exchange. `by` says who answered: the Obi by itself, from what its owner let it tell, or its owner in their own words (spec/protocol.md, 'answer').

by.description: obi: the receiving Obi answered by itself, from what a sharing rule of its owner allows. owner: its owner wrote the answer.

choice.description: The index of the choice picked, when the question had choices.

by_rule.description: The owner's sharing rule that let the Obi answer by itself. Only with by: obi.
